ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious File Download From File Sharing Domain Via Wget.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially suspicious file downloads from file sharing domains using wget.exe

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\wget\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "wget\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.githubusercontent\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*anonfiles\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cdn\\\.discordapp\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ddns\\\.net.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*dl\\\.dropboxusercontent\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ghostbin\\\.co.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*glitch\\\.me.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*gofile\\\.io.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*hastebin\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*mediafire\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*mega\\\.nz.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*onrender\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*pages\\\.dev.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*paste\\\.ee.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*pastebin\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*pastebin\\\.pl.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*pastetext\\\.net.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*pixeldrain\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*privatlab\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*privatlab\\\.net.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*send\\\.exploit\\\.in.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*sendspace\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*storage\\\.googleapis\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*storjshare\\\.io.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*supabase\\\.co.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*temp\\\.sh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*transfer\\\.sh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*trycloudflare\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ufile\\\.io.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*w3spaces\\\.com.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*workers\\\.dev.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\s-O\s") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-output\\-document.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX("\\\.ps1$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.ps1\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.ps1\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dat$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dat\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dat\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.msi$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.msi\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.msi\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.bat$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.bat\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.bat\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbs$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbs\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbs\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbe$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbe\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbe\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.hta$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.hta\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.hta\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dll\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dll\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.psm1$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.psm1\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.psm1\\$")))
